description: This file defines an API endpoint class `UpdateCatalogItemEndpoint` for updating catalog items in an e-commerce web application. It sets up an HTTP PUT route, handles the request to update an existing catalog item, and returns the updated item data.

classes.name: UpdateCatalogItemEndpoint
classes.description: API endpoint class responsible for handling HTTP PUT requests to update catalog items.

methods.name: AddRoute
methods.description: Configures the HTTP PUT route for updating catalog items, including authorization and request handling.

methods.name: HandleAsync
methods.description: Handles the logic of updating an existing catalog item based on the incoming request, including fetching, modifying, and saving changes, then returning the result.
